rationale: The candidate reads as one compact mass in all four views, so gesture clarity is acceptable. However, the form is still basically a split box with a shallow notch/void rather than a convincing public court or active ground threshold on the verified access edge. The top and oblique views show the mass dividing into two bars, but the section does not clearly communicate a usable courtyard, entry seam, or inhabited terrace sequence; the void is too small and semantically weak for the neighborhood-living brief. There is no serious view-to-view collision, so repair integrity is decent, but the overall language feels underdeveloped and somewhat box-like. It can plausibly support neighborhood mixed-use at this scale, yet the dominant relation to street/public space is not strong enough to hard-pass program fit.
